out_of_scope_risks.risk: GitHubTruthStore uses JSONL without fsync durability — f.flush() ensures buffered data reaches the OS, but not the disk platter on power loss
out_of_scope_risks.recommendation: Acceptable for local developer tooling. Add os.fsync() if enterprise durability is required later.
